nom: Neutrogena Age Shield Anti-Oxidant Face Lotion Sunscreen Broad Spectrum Spf 70

avis.texte: i need sunscreen i don’t want anymore wrinkles freckles or sunspots, The damage sun does is visible after it’s to late after too much time gardening yard work with v neck tops. my poor chest area is damaged. So i wear a big hat but Sunscreen is only way to stop block further sun damage. I like the creamy feel my skin is naturally dry so i like the creamy texture and it gives my skin a dewy look. i edit for it to dry then i apply makeup

The product Neutrogena used to sell wasn't good for the aquatic environment, so this is the replacement. It doesn't work into the skin very well. After a few hours, it collects in wrinkles or any other skin crevices. It's just not a good replacement. I have always purchased Neutrogena products in the past, but will be looking for something better for my face. As a side note, after I smooth it into my face, I feel a tickling sensation for a while. I gave it high marks for sun protection because I feel they do a good job with that aspect.

Ordered the pack of 2 and only got a single tube. Support is nonexistent for this item as Amazon says to call Neutrogena directly. Also takes 3 weeks for shipping for some reason. Do not buy this item.
Great product! It’s not that expensive, in fact, fairly inexpensive. The tube is large. If you only use it on your face, it lasts quite a long time. It does leave a nice glow on the skin.

avis.auteur: Kate Reading and Sewing in South Carolin
avis.titre: Protects my face from hot, Southern sun
avis.texte: I garden for hours everyday and despite wearing hats, I need a sunscreen that will protect my face from undue aging. This cream has great protection without causing blemish breakouts. WARNING: when wiping off sweat, wipe away from eyes bc it stings like fire. Also, check for blending well, so you don’t get white streaks.
Quieres un buen protector solar bueno este amiga este llevo 5 años
The product is great, my problem is with the listing. It says 3 ounce (Pack of 2) but I only received one 3 ounce tube.
Solo tengo unas semanas usándolo pero me encanta , tiene una excelente textura , además me hidrata la piel . Sin lugar a dudas lo vuelvo a comprar.

avis.titre: Best sunscreen ever. Definitely with same color shade this year even in this extreme sun
avis.texte: Beat sun protection; used it extreme sun in NYC and definitely retained my skin shade. Loved it; definitely value for money

The Neutrogena product being reviewed is primarily a sun lotion providing an alleged 70% SPF which I can't confirm but I can say the lotion goes on typically greasy as a sun lotion but dries within 5 minutes. It does not have the properties of Neutrogena Healthy Defense Daily Defense with Helioplex pictured here in both the normal and sensitive skin versions. I used the normal version for at least 20 years and it worked very well on my face giving a healthly and youthful look. If you're looking for a face lotion to keep your face hydrated, healthy, young thats non-greasy, don't buy the sun lotion even if they say it's similar to the original Health Defense. Time to leave Neutrogena because they stopped making Healthy Defense and tried to push another product called Boost and this reviewed product. Try Isdin
